pitch:
# A kanban board for a small team

## 1. People and their journey
**Team member** (the only role). Needs to see what work exists, its stage, and who is on it.
Path: open the board → scan columns → create a card in a column → edit title and description → assign teammates → drag the card to the next column as work progresses → remove the card when it is no longer needed.

## 2. How it looks
A kanban board as people know it: a coloured backdrop with a horizontal row of tall, narrow column lists, each holding a vertical stack of white cards.

- **Page backdrop**: fills the whole window, flat blue (#0079BF); behind everything else.
- **Top bar**: full-width strip across the top, flat dark blue (#026AA7), showing the board name in white bold text.
- **Board area**: below the top bar, a horizontal row of columns; scrolls sideways when columns overflow.
- **Column**: light grey (#EBECF0) rounded panel, about 272px wide, raised slightly. While a card is dragged over it, its fill darkens to #DFE1E6.
- **Column header**: top of the column, bold dark grey (#172B4D) column name, with a card count in grey at right. Name becomes an editable text field while being renamed.
- **Card**: white rounded rectangle with a faint shadow inside a column, showing the title in dark text and small round assignee badges at the bottom. Hover: shade darkens slightly. Dragged: tilted slightly, stronger shadow. Its original slot shows a grey placeholder.
- **Assignee badge**: small circle with the member's initials, in that member's own colour; one of six: red #EB5A46, orange #FF9F1A, green #61BD4F, purple #C377E0, sky #00C2E0, pink #FF78CB. Members are given the colours in order of joining, wrapping around.
- **Add-card control**: bottom of each column, flat text "+ Add a card" in grey; hover gives a light grey fill. Click turns it into a text box with a green (#5AAC44) "Add" button and a close "×".
- **Add-column control**: after the last column, translucent white panel reading "+ Add another column"; click opens a name field with green "Add" button and "×".
- **Card dialog**: centred white panel over a dark translucent overlay, containing editable title, description box, assignee list with checkmarks, red "Delete" button and a "×" close.
- **Empty column**: shows only its header and the add-card control.

## 3. How it is used
- Click "+ Add a card": type a title, press Enter or Add; the card appears at the column's bottom.
- Press Escape or click "×" in the add form: the form closes and nothing is created.
- Click a card: opens the card dialog.
- Edit title in the dialog: click it, type, press Enter or click away to save.
- Edit description: click the box, type; it saves when focus leaves.
- Click a member in the dialog's assignee list: toggles assignment on or off.
- Click Delete in the dialog: asks for confirmation, then removes the card.
- Drag a card (mouse), or long-press then drag (finger): a placeholder shows the drop spot; release to place it.
- Drag a card to another column: it moves there at the dropped position.
- Click a column name: rename it; Enter saves, Escape cancels.
- Click "+ Add another column": type a name, Enter adds it at the right end.
- Drag a column header: reorders columns; release to drop.
- Click a column's "⋯" menu, then "Delete column": asks for confirmation, then removes it and its cards.
- Click "×" on the dialog, press Escape, or click the overlay: closes the dialog.

## 4. Scope
One board per team. A member creates columns (stages) and cards, edits, assigns, reorders and moves cards, and deletes them. Excluded: external access, billing, reports, integrations. Forms ask only for a title or name.

## 5. Things and their states
- **Board**: name, ordered columns. Always exists.
- **Column**: name, position, ordered cards. States: empty, populated.
- **Card**: title, description (optional), assignees, column, position. Moves between columns by drag; it ends by deletion.
- **Team member**: name, initials, colour. Assigned to zero or more cards.

## 6. Rules
- Card title is required; an empty title is refused and the form stays open.
- Titles are trimmed; whitespace-only counts as empty.
- Title is at most 200 characters; extra typing is ignored.
- Column name is required, at most 50 characters; an empty rename restores the old name.
- Column names need not be unique.
- A card belongs to exactly one column.
- New cards go to the bottom of their column.
- Dropping a card outside any column returns it to its original place.
- Card order is kept exactly as placed, including after reload.
- A card may have any number of assignees, including none; a member is assigned to a card at most once.
- Deleting a card or column requires confirmation; cancelling changes nothing.
- Deleting a column also deletes its cards, and the confirmation states how many.
- The last remaining column cannot be deleted; the option is shown disabled.
- Changes are saved immediately and shown to all team members.

entities_block:
- **Board** (created by audience): [id: string, name: string, columns: list of Column {id: string, name: string, position: int, cards: list of Card {id: string, title: string, description: string, position: int}}]
- **TeamMember** (created by audience): [id: string, name: string, initials: string, board_id: string]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Card title is required] (Board): Given the add-card form is open in a column When the member submits a title that is empty or only whitespace Then no card is created and the form remains open
- [Card titles are trimmed] (Board): Given the member enters the title '  Design login  ' When the card is saved Then the stored title is 'Design login'
- [Card title maximum length of 200 characters] (Board): Given a card title already has 200 characters When the member types another character Then the character is ignored and the title stays at 200 characters
- [Card title maximum length display] (Board): Given the card dialog title field is focused When the member types up to 200 characters Then all characters are displayed in the field
- [Cancelling the add-card form creates nothing] (Board): Given the add-card form is open with typed text When the member presses Escape or clicks the close control Then the form closes and no card is created
- [New cards are added at the bottom of their column] (Board): Given a column already holds three cards When the member creates a new card with a valid title in that column Then the new card is placed at position four, below the existing cards
- [Card belongs to exactly one column] (Board): Given a card exists in column A When the card is moved to column B Then the card is listed in column B only and not in column A
- [Dropping a card moves it to the dropped position] (Board): Given a card is in column A and column B has two cards When the member drags the card and releases it between the two cards of column B Then the card is in column B at position two and column A no longer contains it
- [Dropping a card outside any column restores it] (Board): Given a card is being dragged from position two of column A When the member releases it outside any column Then the card returns to position two of column A and no other card changes
- [Card order persists exactly as placed] (Board): Given cards are arranged in a specific order in a column When the board is reloaded Then the cards appear in the same order
- [Placeholder shows drop location] (Board): Given a card is being dragged over a column When the pointer is over a drop position Then a grey placeholder is shown at that position
- [Card description is optional] (Board): Given the card dialog is open When the member types a description and moves focus away Then the description is saved; and when the description is left empty Then the card is still valid
- [Title edit saves on Enter or focus loss] (Board): Given the card dialog title is edited to 'Ship v2' When the member presses Enter or clicks away Then the card title is saved as 'Ship v2'
- [Empty title edit is refused] (Board): Given a card titled 'Ship v2' When the member clears the title and saves Then the title remains 'Ship v2'
- [Assignment toggles on and off] (Board): Given a member is not assigned to a card When the member clicks that teammate in the assignee list Then the teammate becomes assigned; and clicking again Then the assignment is removed
- [A member is assigned to a card at most once] (Board): Given a member is already assigned to a card When an assignment for that member is requested again Then the card still holds exactly one assignment for that member; and Given a card has no assignees Then it is still valid
- [Assignee badge colour follows join order] (TeamMember): Given six members have joined in order When a seventh member joins Then the seventh member receives the first colour in the palette again
- [Assignee badge presentation] (TeamMember): Given a card has an assignee When the card is displayed Then a small circle with the member's initials in the member's colour appears at the bottom of the card
- [Card deletion requires confirmation] (Board): Given the card dialog is open When the member clicks Delete and confirms Then the card is removed; and When the member cancels the confirmation Then the card remains unchanged
- [Column name is required and bounded] (Board): Given a column is being renamed When the member submits an empty name Then the old name is restored; and When a name of 51 characters is entered Then it is refused or truncated to 50 characters
- [Column rename saves on Enter and cancels on Escape] (Board): Given a column name is being edited to 'Review' When the member presses Enter Then the column is named 'Review'; and When the member presses Escape instead Then the previous name is kept
- [Column names need not be unique] (Board): Given a column named 'Done' exists When the member adds another column named 'Done' Then the board contains both columns
- [New column is added at the right end] (Board): Given a board has three columns When the member enters the name 'QA' and presses Enter Then a fourth column named 'QA' is added at the right end
- [Column reorder by dragging header] (Board): Given columns A, B and C in that order When the member drags column C's header to the left of A and releases Then the order is C, A, B
- [Column deletion requires confirmation and removes its cards] (Board): Given a column holds four cards When the member chooses Delete column and confirms Then the column and its four cards are removed; and When the member cancels Then nothing changes
- [Last remaining column cannot be deleted] (Board): Given a board has exactly one column When the member opens the column menu Then the Delete column option is disabled and no column is removed
- [Empty column shows only header and add control] (Board): Given a column holds no cards When the board is displayed Then the column shows its header and the add-card control and no cards
- [Changes are saved immediately and shared] (Board): Given a member creates or moves a card When the change is made Then all team members see the change without a manual save action
- [Board shows name in top bar] (Board): Given a board named 'Team Work' exists When the board is opened Then the top bar displays 'Team Work' in white bold text
- [Card dialog closes without losing saved data] (Board): Given the card dialog is open When the member presses Escape, clicks the close control or clicks the overlay Then the dialog closes
intent_block:
- Product type: internal_tool
- Audience: members of a small team tracking their shared work
- Goal: Let the team see what work exists, what stage each item is in, and who is doing it, by moving cards across columns on a board.
- Scope: A single kanban board per team, made of ordered columns containing cards that team members create, edit, assign, and move between columns.
- The model must cover: boards and their ordered columns (workflow stages); cards representing work items, with title and description; team members and card assignment; card position and movement between columns
- Do NOT model: customer or external user access; billing or subscription management; reporting or analytics dashboards; integrations with other tools
